verdict.rationale: Anrok's marketing shows a world exposure map with sales data by jurisdiction and a UK registration threshold tracker. It also promises "early alerts before you owe anywhere," and its dashboards show tax obligations across 13 countries, all fed by transactions synced through its Transactions API. Together these cover the core of proactive economic nexus monitoring for states and countries. missing for 10: explicit evidence of transaction-count (not just sales-amount) threshold tracking, detailed docs on alert mechanics and timing, confirmation of coverage of every state/country threshold, independent or hands-on corroboration.
